name: Apply Wall Primer (Roll Method)
intent: Cut in to ceiling line freehand with brush, then roll primer onto bare drywall walls with an 18-inch roller. Single coat of primer regardless of QT — primer never gets a second coat in NC residential. Texture variants (orange peel, knockdown) require slower laydown to fill the profile.
doctrine: Primer cut-in is slower than finish cut-in because the painter is fighting wet primer that can lap-mark visibly even though it's hidden by finish coats — the prime cut-in line establishes where the finish painter will cut in, so straightness matters at QT4. Roll primer baseline (350 SF/hr) is the smooth rate; FAC_TEXTURE handles the textured slowdown — tune there if the textured:smooth ratio needs adjusting. QT4 slowdown comes from FAC_QT separately, so no special collapse logic needed here.
